book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The Mongolia reached Aden, and then Bombay.
On 20 October, two days ahead of schedule.
Fogg wrote in his notebook: two days gained.

sentences.ar: والقطار لكلكتا بيطلع الساعة تمانية بالليل.
sentences.en: And the train to Calcutta left at eight at night.

sentences.ar: فراح فوغ للقنصلية، وختم جوازه، ورجع للمحطة، وأكل.
sentences.en: So Fogg went to the consulate, stamped his passport, went back to the station, and ate.
And Passepartout went out to look around.
And Fix ran to the police.

sentences.ar: وقال: وصلت مذكرة توقيف من لندن؟
sentences.en: And said: has a warrant arrived from London?
They said: no.
And Fix struck the table.
The telegram is faster than the steamer.

sentences.ar: بس المذكرة ورقة، والورقة بتيجي بالباخرة الجاية.
sentences.en: But the warrant is a paper, and the paper comes on the next steamer.

sentences.ar: وقال: بس هو مش رح يوقف.
sentences.en: And said: but he will not stop.
I must stop him myself.

sentences.ar: أما باسبارتو، فكان ماشي بشوارع بومباي، مبهور.
sentences.en: As for Passepartout, he walked the streets of Bombay, dazzled.
Colours, smells, people, elephants, sounds.

sentences.ar: وشاف معبد كبير، حلو، وقال: بدي أشوفه من جوا.
sentences.en: And saw a big, beautiful temple, and said: I want to see it from inside.
And went in, with his shoes on.
And did not know it was forbidden.

sentences.ar: وتلات كهنة نطوا عليه، وقلعوا جزمته، وضربوه.
sentences.en: And three priests leapt on him, tore off his shoes, and beat him.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو، اللي كان بهلوان، ضربهم وهرب.
sentences.en: And Passepartout, who had been an acrobat, hit them and fled.
Barefoot, his hat gone, his shirt torn.

sentences.ar: وصل للمحطة الساعة 7:55، ووقف قدام فوغ.
sentences.en: He reached the station at 7:55, and stood before Fogg.
Fogg said: no shoes?
And Passepartout told.
And Fogg said: fine.
Get on.
And they boarded the train.

sentences.ar: وفيكس، اللي كان واقف عالرصيف، سمع كل شي.
sentences.en: And Fix, who had been standing on the platform, heard everything.
And smiled.
And said: the servant hit priests in a temple.
And that in India is a crime.
And he went to the priests.
